threat: The implemented study does not evaluate the full LIBERO-Plus suite.
implication: Claims are restricted to the implemented LIBERO-Spatial tasks and language/photometric/noise conditions.
future_work: Evaluate camera viewpoint, object-layout and robot-initial-state shifts.

threat: Training-side environmental augmentation is limited to brightness, contrast and saturation.
implication: Mixed visual results should not be generalized to all environmental-augmentation strategies.
future_work: Investigate geometry-aware, sensor-aware and broader corruption training.

threat: M2-L and M2-E are mechanism ablations at seed 42 only.
implication: They explain mechanisms but do not provide multi-seed confirmation.
future_work: Replicate component ablations across more training seeds in a future study.

threat: Success varies materially across independent optimization seeds.
future_work: Use larger seed counts and hierarchical uncertainty in future work.

threat: Automated failure labels are proxies rather than full semantic trajectory diagnoses.
implication: Failure-type conclusions require curated trajectory/video inspection.
future_work: Perform manual semantic failure annotation on representative successful/failed episodes.

threat: The study establishes simulator robustness, not physical-robot reliability.
implication: No direct sim-to-real claim is justified.
future_work: Validate the robustness pattern on a physical manipulation platform.

threat: E5 was motivated after definitive E0–E4 outcomes were observed.
implication: E5 is supplementary exploratory evidence rather than confirmatory evidence.
future_work: Predeclare double-held-out conditions in an independent future replication.
